entries.title: The Chat guide can open a web page you give it
entries.body: When you type to the guide in the Chat panel, it can now open and read one web page in each answer, such as an address you paste in, and link to what it found. Talking to the article out loud still sticks to the article alone.

entries.title: Notes the author attached to links appear in the card
entries.body: Words an author put on a link, picture or abbreviation used to show only in the browser's grey box. They appear in the card you see when pointing at it, marked "from the article"; notes that just repeat the link's words or address are left out. Screen readers still get them where a link or picture has no other name.
